svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What each layer can hold an edit to
svg.text: The request names a button; the rules name files
The request names an element. Each layer below it can only hold the edit to a coarser shape.
What the sandbox or the default edit mode lets the agent write to. Every file in the repo.
Held by: OS sandbox, or the harness's edit auto-accept scope
A path deny rule or a pre-edit hook. Holds for the agent's edit tools and the shell commands
the harness recognizes; not for a script that opens the file itself.
Held by: harness permission rules, hooks
Inside an allowed file, a shared selector still repaints other elements. No rule sees this.
Held by: the request as text, and whoever reads the diff
Layout ours. Scope descriptions from the Claude Code permissions and hooks documentation and the Codex
approvals and security documentation, retrieved 20 September 2026.
